assign-org.title: Assign {name} to the whole organization
org-notice: The device will run tasks of every workgroup, also of workgroups created later. To run them it receives the keys of every workgroup: whoever controls the device can read their tasks, chats and whiteboards and the access data of their members. To keep a workgroup off the device, assign it to single workgroups instead.
unassign-org.title: Remove {name} from the organization
unassign-org.body: The device no longer runs tasks of every workgroup; workgroups it is assigned to on their own keep it. The keys of the other workgroups are replaced. Content it already read stays on the device.
